description: Design service-level ownership context propagation from token (brand claim) through session.service.ts and ownership.service.ts to repository calls, with explicit tenant/subject threading and denial of unknown provenance
steps: Read FEAT-001 findings for credential propagation gaps: packages/auth/src/token.service.ts has brand claim, but session.service.ts and ownership.service.ts use userId only
Read packages/auth/src/rbac/ownership.service.ts (current implementation). Note OwnershipContext interface has requestingUserId, resourceOwnerId, userRoles but no tenantId

Design enhanced OwnershipContext: Add tenantId: string field. Update OwnershipRBACService.hasPermissionOrOwnership to check requestingUserId === resourceOwnerId AND requestingTenantId === resourceTenantId. Update ForbiddenError messages to distinguish 'not owner' from 'wrong tenant'

Design session.service.ts enhancement: SessionRepository.create and Session type must include tenantId. Extract tenantId from JWT brand claim when creating session (map brand enum to tenantId). Update validateSession to return tenantId in session object

Design tenant propagation pattern: Services receive tenantId as explicit parameter (not ambient context). Example: TutorialProgressRepository.getProgress(tenantId: string, userId: string, subtopicId: string). Repositories validate tenantId IS NOT NULL before queries (reject unknown provenance)

Design unknown provenance denial: At API route entry, extract tenantId from validated token. If tenantId is null/undefined, return 403 Forbidden before repository calls. Document: session metadata (IP, device) is NOT identity authority per directive

Design brand-to-tenant mapping: If tenant table exists, map JWT brand claim to tenantId via lookup. If tenant is platform enum only, use brand value directly as tenantId text. Document mapping service location (packages/auth/src/tenant.service.ts or inline in token.service.ts)

Trace impacted services: List all service files calling ownership.service.ts or session.service.ts (grep -r 'OwnershipRBACService\|SessionService' packages/ apps/). For each, determine how tenantId will be threaded from request → service → repository

Design export ownership enhancement: apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/download/route.ts currently checks job.userId === payload.userId. Add tenantId extraction from payload (via TokenService). Add job.tenantId check: if (job.tenantId !== payload.tenantId) throw forbidden('Tenant mismatch'). Preserve existing userId check as second layer

Design progress ownership enhancement: packages/db-tutorial/src/repositories/tutorial-progress.repository.ts methods (getProgress, markBlockComplete, isSubtopicComplete) must accept tenantId parameter. Update WHERE clauses: and(eq(tutorialProgress.tenantId, tenantId), eq(tutorialProgress.userId, userId), ...)

Write service design document at .agents/tasks/fnd03-ownership-architecture/service-changes.md with: Executive Summary, Enhanced OwnershipContext (TypeScript interface), Session Service Changes, Tenant Propagation Pattern (with code examples), Unknown Provenance Denial (at route entry), Brand-to-Tenant Mapping, Export Download Enhancement, Progress Repository Enhancement, Impacted Service List, Migration Strategy (add tenantId parameters in stages)
acceptance_criteria: service-changes.md contains enhanced OwnershipContext interface with tenantId field
Tenant propagation pattern documented: explicit parameter threading from route → service → repository
Unknown provenance denial documented: 403 before repository calls if tenantId is null
Export download route enhancement designed with tenantId check before storage access
Progress repository enhancement designed with tenantId in WHERE clauses
Impacted services listed with required signature changes
verification: grep 'tenantId.*string' service-changes.md (expect enhanced OwnershipContext and repository signatures)
grep 'unknown provenance\|tenantId IS NOT NULL' service-changes.md (confirm denial strategy documented)
